title: Branding
coreMove: Test whether history-backed trust lets a similar product command a real premium.
sourcePressure: Branding creates higher willingness to pay for an objectively similar offering. The barrier is the time and uncertainty required to copy trust and emotional meaning, while allowing several strong brands to coexist.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Branding means awareness, logos, storytelling, or any positive reputation.

sourceAnchors.name: higher willingness to pay
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar defines branding power as higher willingness to pay for an objectively similar offering
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A brand earns power only when a buyer pays more for the same functional job because history has reduced doubt.
